prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In & Sync Your Pets", "Log in to restore your existing desktop pets, items, and cloud save data instantly.", "Signing in ensures your companions and progress are linked safely to your account.", "Automatic Cloud Sync Active"]
1: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Select a well-lit, clear front-facing image of your pet for best render results.", "Avoid blurry images or dark lighting for optimal generation."]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Pet!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop. Use quick shortcuts to control and interact anytime."]
3: ["Choose Your Journey", "Select how you want to interact with your desktop companion.", "Confirm Your Path", "Pick your preferred onboarding adventure and start customising your companion."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "Initializing desktop overlay graphics engine and loading pet animations...", "Initializing Desktop Engine...", "Desktop Overlay Active"]
5: ["Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pets", "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your existing account to instantly restore your pets and items.", "Signing in connects your local app session with your saved account data."]
6: ["Use a clear, bright photo showing your pet's full face for realistic 3D desktop rendering."]
7: ["Creating desktop overlay shaders. Your pet will spawn shortly."]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Click on your desktop pet anytime to chat, feed, or adjust companion visibility settings.", "Start Desktop Session"]
9: ["Select Your Onboarding Path", "Each path unlocks unique initial companion traits and desktop animations.", "You can customize pet behaviors anytime after completing onboarding."]
